note: Versions the campaign compiler consumes from the pinned FWGC++ producer (commit ec5d1c10); heroes (realms and people) is pinned since MMR-27. Observed in that producer's split exports at sizes 129/257/513, seed 42. generator_version is descriptive metadata, not a build fingerprint. Unknown optional members are skipped; a missing or unsupported required member fails before any game file is written.

tolerances.note: Absolute. FWGC++ writes the seam column and pole rows by exact copy (grid.cpp; tests use exact equality); every layer of the pinned producer's exports at 129/257/513/1025 shows 0 difference.

limits.note: max_retained_bytes caps what the reader keeps after streaming (record strings at length+32, structs, positions); the pinned producer's exports retain 0.70-0.81 MB at sizes 129-1025. The tokenizer separately caps open-object keys at 16 MiB, tokens at 1 MiB and nesting at 64. Worst-case peak working set is therefore about 11 MB of process baseline plus these budgets, plus 8*side^2 bytes per materialized layer held.

integral_layers_note: Categorical layers: every sample must be integer-valued (FWGC++ writes integer codes as shortest round-trip doubles).
